properties.title: Subglacial lakes boundaries and elevation time series data
properties.description: Antarctic subglacial lake boundaries joined to elevation time series. Contains 4,692 rows, 21 columns and 159 distinct lake-period identifiers. Rows contain boundary-period dates, a contour value, and inside/outside lake elevation anomalies, counts and uncertainty fields. 109 rows have no geometry; their dates are included in the temporal extent. The spatial extent encloses the non-null polygons. Temporal coverage includes both boundary periods and elevation observations.
